description: The file defines a Razor ViewComponent named 'Basket' used for displaying shopping basket info in a web application. It interacts with basket services and user authentication to determine item counts, supporting both signed-in users and anonymous users via cookies.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: A ViewComponent that renders the shopping basket summary, handling both authenticated and anonymous users.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds and returns the basket view model with item count.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total number of basket items for the current user or anonymous session.

methods.name: GetAnnonymousIdFromCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the anonymous basket ID from cookies if valid.
